snippet.title: GROWTH | Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
*GROWTH* is an upcoming mod for Portal 2, running on the Strata engine. Inspired by concept art from Valve's cancelled *F-Stop* project, integrated with many ideas from the developers, as well as unique characters and an intriguing story, this is what *GROWTH* is.

ModDB: https://www.moddb.com/mods/growth
Steam: Coming Soon
